note: NIFTY 50 membership by date, rebuilt from NSE's index-change announcements. A stock is a member from its 'from' date (inclusive) to its 'to' date (exclusive). Dates are the changes' effective dates. Two members of the period have no Angel history (see 'no_data'); TATAMOTORS is one continuous series through its Oct 2025 rename to TMPV.

changes.uncertain: Today's list (stock_universe) has BSE in and WIPRO out; the announcement itself was not available, so the effective date is taken as the March 2026 review. The September 2026 review is the alternative and is run as a sensitivity.

no_data.HDFC: Delisted 2023-07-13 on its merger into HDFC Bank; Angel serves no history. NIFTY 50 has 49 tradable members until then.
no_data.LTIM: Not in the app's instrument master. Member 2023-07-13 .. 2024-09-30 only; 49 tradable members in that span.

renamed.TATAMOTORS: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TMPV) from the Oct 2025 demerger; Angel's series is continuous (no jump at the record date).
